bmt-2022-discrete-tiebreaker-01.prompt: How many three-digit positive integers have digits which sum to a multiple of $10$?

bmt-2022-discrete-tiebreaker-02.prompt: A positive integer is called *extra-even* if all of its digits are even. Compute the number of positive integers $n$ less than or equal to $2022$ such that both $n$ and $2n$ are extra-even.

bmt-2022-discrete-tiebreaker-03.prompt: Let $A$ be the product of all positive integers less than $1000$ whose ones or hundreds digit is $7$. Compute the remainder when $A/101$ is divided by $101$.
